title: a-shim-status-pane-carries-a-pid
intention: Every device's shim status pane carries its PID, answering 'am I running, and as what' uniformly across devices.
why: The generalization of the parent: every device answers 'am I running, and as what' the same way.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured: 'am I running' is a measurement
Law 10 — nothing in the system is immeasurable: PID + liveness is the instrument

falsifier.proves_red: The pane shows a pid that is not the device's own process — the failure this ticket is being held to avoid.
